description: A utility module for formatting currency values consistently across a frontend application. It provides functions to format numeric amounts as currency strings, including features like dynamic decimal precision, optional inclusion of associated credit values, and specific handling for USD currency. The functions support flexible options for customizing the formatting behavior.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount(value, options = {})
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a currency string, with options for currency, decimal precision, and optional credits suffix. Ensures consistent display with dynamic decimal handling for different magnitudes.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText(usd, options = {})
methods.description: Convenience function to format USD amounts with appended credits information, utilizing 'formatCurrencyAmount' internally.

methods.name: formatUsdUpToSixDecimals(amount)
methods.description: Formats a USD amount with up to six decimal places, ensuring clarity for small or precise values.
